name: Date & Rocket Salad
description: Fresh rocket leaves paired with premium Khalas dates, feta cheese, and walnuts, tossed in a date molasses and lemon dressing.

name: Yogurt Cucumber Salad
description: A refreshing traditional mix of diced cucumbers, tomatoes, and fresh mint in a chilled garlic-yogurt dressing.

name: Meat Sambusa
description: Crispy golden pastry triangles filled with seasoned minced beef, Saudi spices, and fresh coriander.

name: Hummus with Minced Meat
description: Creamy chickpea dip with tahini and lemon, topped with sautéed spiced minced meat and pine nuts, served with fresh hot bread.

name: Smoked Mutabbal
description: Char-grilled eggplant mashed with tahini, garlic, and yogurt, garnished with fresh pomegranate seeds and olive oil.

name: Megalgal Lamb Liver
description: Fresh lamb liver flash-fried with onions, green bell peppers, and a rich blend of traditional spices.

name: Cheese Sambusa
description: Crispy golden fried pastry triangles stuffed with a savory melting cheese blend and a hint of mint.

name: Chicken Kabsa Pizza
description: Italian pizza crust topped with Kabsa-spiced tomato sauce, grilled shredded chicken, mozzarella, and fresh coriander.

name: Megalgal Beef Pizza
description: A savory fusion topped with traditional Saudi sautéed beef (Megalgal), onions, bell peppers, and melting Kashkaval cheese.

name: Three-Cheese & Mint Pizza
description: A delightful regional blend of Akawi, Mozzarella, and Feta cheeses topped with crushed dried mint and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Haneeni
description: A warm traditional Najdi dessert made of whole wheat bread crumbs mashed with premium dates, butter, and cardamom.

name: Southern Areeka
description: A popular rich dessert from the southern region made of brown flour dough and dates, drenched in pure ghee, honey, and cream.

name: Masabeeb with Honey
description: Miniature Saudi whole wheat pancakes baked on a griddle, served warm with a generous drizzle of natural honey or melted ghee.

name: Luqaimat with Date Syrup
description: Crunchy sweet dumplings, soft on the inside, drizzled with rich date molasses and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Kingfish (Kanad)

name: Sweet & Sour Fish Mutabbaq
description: Fried local Shaari fish cooked in a tangy tamarind and caramelized onion sauce, served over aromatic red rice.

name: Rotisserie Chicken with Bukhari Rice
description: Half rotisserie chicken roasted to golden perfection, served over fragrant Bukhari rice tossed with grated carrots and raisins.

name: Megalgal Hashi (Camel Meat)
description: Tender pieces of premium camel meat stir-fried with onions, tomatoes, and Saudi spices, served with fresh flatbread.

name: Lamb Madghout
description: Succulent lamb pressure-cooked directly with rice, tomatoes, and whole spices, making the meat incredibly tender and flavorful.

name: Taifi Chicken Saleeg

name: Premium Naemi Lamb Kabsa

name: Iced Hibiscus Drink (Karkadeh)

name: Tamarind Drink (Tamr Hindi)
description: A sweet and tangy traditional chilled drink made from real tamarind fruit, popular for its cooling properties[cite: 2].

name: Refreshing Lemon Mint Juice
description: Freshly squeezed lemon juice blended perfectly with fresh mint leaves and crushed ice[cite: 2].

name: Chilled Ayran Laban
description: A savory, slightly salty yogurt drink, ideal for balancing out rich rice dishes[cite: 2].

name: Saudi Coffee with Cardamom & Saffron
description: Traditional blonde coffee brewed from premium Harari beans, infused with cardamom and saffron, traditionally served with fresh dates.

name: Adani Karak Tea
description: A rich, sweetened black tea slow-brewed with evaporated milk, cardamom, cloves, and a touch of saffron.
